proposed_constraints.subject: data.redacted_customer_ticket
proposed_constraints.rationale: Suggested for the user to confirm: record that ticket text reaches any remote provider only after the local redactor. Informational, so it is recorded and not scored.

proposed_candidates.rationale: Local-first: drafting stays inside the local trust boundary and depends on no remote provider. A model, a runtime, a hardware-fit observation and a citation-validity evaluation are all still needed.
Hybrid managed: redaction stays local and drafting uses a managed API. A provider, a region, pricing, residency documentation and a citation-validity evaluation are all still needed.

questions: Which managed providers and regions, if any, may process redacted tickets with internal context?
Must response drafting keep working when every remote provider is unavailable?

inferences.subject: candidate.response_drafting.local_first.latency
inferences.claim: Local drafting latency depends on the model chosen and on the declared RTX 4090; nothing has been measured, so the 5000 ms p95 preference cannot be judged yet.

rationale.summary: Two meaningfully different alternatives for response drafting: local-first and hybrid managed. Neither has been evaluated, and neither is claimed to be viable.
